name: Ferienwohnung Arnold
beschreibung:
Quietly situated on the sunny plateau of Schwoich, Ferienwohnung Arnold welcomes guests with a warm family ambiance and comfortable fittings. Bright rooms, a modern kitchenette, and a sunny garden area provide ample room to unwind.

Scenic trails lead directly to tranquil forest lakes and alpine pastures, while swimming lakes and regional ski areas are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Arnold in Schwoich offers a relaxing family holiday retreat with unhindered views of the Kaiser mountains.
